,"AHT20":{
    "_notes": "Aosong AHT20 (also AHT21/AHT25/DHT20) at 0x38. Data format: Status(8bit) + Humidity(20bit) + Temperature(20bit) (+ CRC, not read). Conversion: humidity(%) = (H[19:0]/2^20)*100, temp(°C) = (T[19:0]/2^20)*200-50. Detection: a bare read of the status byte with bits 6:5 = 0 - weak, but it passes idle (0x1C), measuring (busy bit 7 set: the AHT20 answers rather than NACKing) and just after a soft reset (0x80, calibration bit clear), so it can't fail on a genuine part; a Trill Ring's reply starts 0xFE. Init: calibrate (0xBE0800), 10 ms. Poll: trigger (0xAC3300), 80 ms (the measurement time; a read before then gives incomplete data with a valid CRC), read 6 bytes.",

    "_notes": "Sensirion SCD30 CO2/temperature/humidity at 0x61 (SEL to GND or floating for I2C: SEL high at power-up selects Modbus and the sensor never answers on I2C). No detection values: 0x61 is in the RSAO identification hook's probe range, and a detection that could fail would let the hook send it framed bytes (as the STCC4, devdocs/stcc4-identification-notes.md). Not scanned while polled (scanWhilePolled false): a scanner presence probe stops it producing data (data-ready never set while probed every few seconds); its polls show it's there. Init: firmware version (0xD100), read the measurement interval (0x4600), start continuous measurement with no pressure compensation (0x0010 0x0000), then set the interval to 2 s only if it differs ({?setInterval}, computed by initCode) as it's stored in non-volatile memory. ASC is left as stored (the autoCal action sets it). Commands are followed by a pause before the read (the SCD30 needs 3 ms). Poll (every 3 s, longer than the 2 s measurement): data-ready (0x0202) twice, then read measurement (0x0300): CO2, T and RH as big-endian floats, each 2-byte half followed by a CRC. Decode: a sample only when the second data-ready word is 1 (a read before data is ready gives 0xFFFF words), with the floats built from their bits. Rates (_conf.rate) only set the poll interval, 3 s to 60 s. Actions (each stored in non-volatile memory): autoCal (automatic self-calibration, 1 on, 0 off), forceCal (forced recalibration to a reference ppm - run in that concentration for at least 2 minutes first), tempOffset (degrees C, subtracted from the temperature), altitude (m); pressure restarts measurement with ambient pressure compensation (mbar, 0 off); softReset. autoCal needs regular fresh air (about 1 hour a day; first correction after about 7 days). forceCal: measure in the reference concentration for at least 2 minutes first.",

,"STCC4":{
    "_notes": "Sensirion STCC4 miniature CO2 sensor (paired with SHT41 for RH/T compensation), fixed address 0x64. Detection is empty (unique address) - the product-ID command cannot be used because the detection path issues a single write+read with no inter-command delay and the STCC4 NACKs that read - so the record claims any device at 0x64. Init: start_continuous_measurement (0x218B). Poll every 1.5 s (longer than the 1 s measurement, so the read always has new data; at 1 s the two drift and a read is NACKed now and then): read_measurement (0xEC05), 1 ms pause, read 12 bytes = CO2/temp/humidity/status words each followed by a CRC byte (skipped via 'at'). CO2 is signed (i16 in the datasheet). Status: only bit 0x0040 (testing mode) is documented; after power-up 0x0100 was seen for about 2 minutes. Actions: testingMode (pauses ASC), pressure (hPa). Forced recalibration isn't an action: it needs measurement stopped (1.2 s), then FRC, then a restart. Datasheet: https://sensirion.com/media/documents/6AED4B15/69295E41/CD_DS_STCC4_D1.pdf. Rates (_conf.rate) only set the poll interval, 1.5 s to 60 s. CO2 raw = ppm; temperature = -45 + 175*s/65535; humidity = -6 + 125*s/65535. Must never be probed by the RSAO delegated-identification hook (its framed 0x99 command stops the sensor measuring); RaftI2C DeviceIdentMgr only runs that hook when no device-type record matches - this record's empty detection always matches, so the hook is never reached at 0x64. See devdocs/stcc4-identification-notes.md testingMode: 1 enable_testing_mode (0x3FBC), 0 disable_testing_mode (0x3F3D); ASC is always on otherwise. pressure: sent as Pa/2, reset to 1013 hPa at power-up.",

,"VL6180":{
    "_notes": "VL6180X ToF proximity sensor with 1x range scaling (RANGE_SCALER 0x0096/0x0097=>0x00fd), so the range is an 8-bit value in mm (0-255). Specified range 0-100mm, typically up to ~200mm with a reflective target and low ambient light\nInit: write 0x0018=>0x01 then wait 100ms, which stops continuous ranging left running by a previous init (the sensor may not have been power cycled) or otherwise does one harmless single-shot range; AN4545 private settings https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an4545-vl6180x-basic-ranging-application-note-stmicroelectronics.pdf; clear SYSTEM__FRESH_OUT_OF_RESET (0x0016=>0x00); GPIO1 interrupt output active low (0x0011=>0x10); readout averaging period 4.3ms (0x010a=>0x30); VHV recalibration every 255 ranges (0x0031=>0xff) and once now (0x002e=>0x01); range inter-measurement period 90ms (0x001b=>0x08); interrupt on new range sample only (0x0014=>0x04); clear interrupts (0x0015=>0x07); start continuous ranging (0x0018=>0x03)\nPoll: RESULT__RANGE_STATUS, RESULT__ALS_STATUS and RESULT__INTERRUPT_STATUS_GPIO (0x004d-0x004f), RESULT__RANGE_VAL (0x0062), then clear interrupts (0x0015=>0x07)\nerr is the range error code (0x004d bits 7:4) and valid is true only when it is 0. With no target in range err is typically 6 (early convergence estimate), 7 (max convergence time) or 11 (signal to noise) and the raw range reads 255\nfresh is 1 when a new range sample completed since the previous poll (0x004f bit 2, new sample ready) and 0 when the poll re-read the previous sample\nSample rate (_conf.rate): the sensor's inter-measurement period (0x001b) is set shorter than the poll interval so that every poll normally sees a new sample. Up to 10Hz the period is 90ms with the default max convergence time 49ms (0x001c=>0x31) and readout averaging 4.3ms. 20Hz uses a 40ms period, 25ms max convergence and 4.3ms averaging. 50Hz uses a 10ms period, 3ms max convergence and 1.8ms averaging (0x010a=>0x08), which reduces range on dark targets and increases noise. Ranging is stopped while the timing is changed and then restarted\nAmbient light sensing (ALS) is not used",

    "_notes": "Aosong AHT20 (also AHT21/AHT25/DHT20) at 0x38. Data format: Status(8bit) + Humidity(20bit) + Temperature(20bit) (+ CRC, not read). Conversion: humidity(%) = (H[19:0]/2^20)*100, temp(°C) = (T[19:0]/2^20)*200-50. Detection: a bare read of the status byte with bits 6:5 = 0 - weak, but it passes idle (0x1C), measuring (busy bit 7 set: the AHT20 answers rather than NACKing) and just after a soft reset (0x80, calibration bit clear), so it can't fail on a genuine part; a Trill Ring's reply starts 0xFE.     "_notes": "Maxim MAX30101 / MAX30105 pulse oximetry, heart-rate and particle sensor at 0x57 (fixed). The MAX30102 has the same part ID but no green LED (its green values are meaningless). Detection: PART_ID (0xFF) = 0x15 (all three). Poll: FIFO_WR_PTR, OVF_COUNTER, FIFO_RD_PTR, then 8 samples of 9 bytes from FIFO_DATA (the register pointer stays at 0x07, so one read covers both), 18 bits per LED; then FIFO_RD_PTR again. The decode keeps the samples the read popped (RD_PTR after minus before): a read of an empty FIFO returns the last sample again without moving RD_PTR, and a sample that arrives during the read (about 8 ms) is popped too - counting from the pointers before the read dropped it, about one sample in five at 100/s (bench, 2026-10-24). The rate is the 100 samples/s divided by the on-chip averaging (1-16), each rate polled often enough to keep under 8 samples a poll. In multi-LED mode an LED is turned off by setting its current to 0, so the LED actions also choose what is measured (red only for heart rate, red and IR for SpO2, all three). Bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-24, MAX30105): with nothing in front about 1500 (red) and 2400 (IR), a fingertip about 196000 with a 68 bpm pulse of about 1700 p-p in IR.",

    "_notes": "TE MS8607 pressure and temperature part at 0x76 (fixed; the humidity part is MS8607RH at 0x40). Commands, not registers: reset 0x1E, convert pressure 0x40-0x4A / temperature 0x50-0x5A (by oversampling), ADC read 0x00 (3 bytes), PROM read 0xA0-0xAC (7 words: word 0 holds a CRC-4, words 1-6 the coefficients C1-C6). Detection: an ADC read, then a second one, which returns 0 whatever went before (datasheet: a repeated ADC read gives 0) - a pattern rather than an ID (a BME280's register 0x00 also reads 0), so it is tried after the records with an ID (identPriority -1). Init: reset, 5 ms. Poll: pressure conversion at OSR 8192 (0x4A, max 16.4 ms), 20 ms (the address is barred), read; temperature conversion (0x5A), 20 ms, read; C1-C6. Decode: TE's first- and second-order compensation (also right for the MS5637 and MS5837-02BA, which share the maths; not the MS5611 or MS5837-30BA). The PROM CRC-4 isn't checked (the grammar can't). 0x76 is also a common multiplexer address (Axiom018 reserved it until 2026-10-18).",

    "_notes": "TE MS8607 humidity part at 0x40 (fixed; the pressure and temperature part is MS8607PT at 0x76). HTU21-style commands: reset 0xFE, measure RH without clock stretching 0xF5 (with stretching, 0xE5, holds the clock longer than the bus timeout), user register read 0xE7. Detection: the user register's fixed bits (reserved bits 5:3 = 0, bit 1 = 1 by default) - weak, so it is tried after the records with an ID (identPriority -1); 0x40 is also used by parts with no record (INA219, PCA9685). Poll: measure (0xF5), 20 ms (max 16 ms at 12 bits; the pause bars the address, as an address probe between trigger and read loses the result), read 3 bytes (RH, CRC with init 0x00 - not checked). ,"VL6180":{
    "_notes": "VL6180X ToF proximity sensor with 1x range scaling (RANGE_SCALER 0x0096/0x0097=>0x00fd), so the range is an 8-bit value in mm (0-255). Specified range 0-100mm, typically up to ~200mm with a reflective target and low ambient light\nInit: write 0x0018=>0x01 then wait 100ms, which stops continuous ranging left running by a previous init (the sensor may not have been power cycled) or otherwise does one harmless single-shot range; AN4545 private settings https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an4545-vl6180x-basic-ranging-application-note-stmicroelectronics.pdf; clear SYSTEM__FRESH_OUT_OF_RESET (0x0016=>0x00); GPIO1 interrupt output active low (0x0011=>0x10); readout averaging period 4.3ms (0x010a=>0x30); VHV recalibration every 255 ranges (0x0031=>0xff) and once now (0x002e=>0x01); range inter-measurement period 90ms (0x001b=>0x08); interrupt on new range sample only (0x0014=>0x04); clear interrupts (0x0015=>0x07); start continuous ranging (0x0018=>0x03)\nPoll: RESULT__RANGE_STATUS, RESULT__ALS_STATUS and RESULT__INTERRUPT_STATUS_GPIO (0x004d-0x004f), RESULT__RANGE_VAL (0x0062), then clear interrupts (0x0015=>0x07)\nerr is the range error code (0x004d bits 7:4) and valid is true only when it is 0. With no target in range err is typically 6 (early convergence estimate), 7 (max convergence time) or 11 (signal to noise) and the raw range reads 255\nfresh is 1 when a new range sample completed since the previous poll (0x004f bit 2, new sample ready) and 0 when the poll re-read the previous sample\nSample rate (_conf.rate): the sensor's inter-measurement period (0x001b) is set shorter than the poll interval so that every poll normally sees a new sample. Up to 10Hz the period is 90ms with the default max convergence time 49ms (0x001c=>0x31) and readout averaging 4.3ms. 20Hz uses a 40ms period, 25ms max convergence and 4.3ms averaging. 50Hz uses a 10ms period, 3ms max convergence and 1.8ms averaging (0x010a=>0x08), which reduces range on dark targets and increases noise. Ranging is stopped while the timing is changed and then restarted\nAmbient light sensing (ALS) is not used",

    "_notes": "Maxim MAX30101 / MAX30105 pulse oximetry, heart-rate and particle sensor at 0x57 (fixed). The MAX30102 has the same part ID but no green LED (its green values are meaningless). Detection: PART_ID (0xFF) = 0x15 (all three). Init: reset (0x09 bit 6), 10 ms; MODE_CONFIG (0x09) multi-LED mode (7); FIFO_CONFIG (0x08) 4-sample averaging, rollover on, almost-full 15; INT status 1 read (clears it); SPO2_CONFIG (0x0A) ADC range 4096 nA, 100 samples/s, 411 us pulses (18 bits); LED1-LED3 pulse amplitudes (0x0C-0x0E, red, IR, green) 0x40 = 12.8 mA (0.2 mA per step); slots (0x11-0x12) red, IR, green, none; FIFO pointers cleared (0x04-0x06). Poll: FIFO_WR_PTR, OVF_COUNTER, FIFO_RD_PTR, then 8 samples of 9 bytes from FIFO_DATA (the register pointer stays at 0x07, so one read covers both), 18 bits per LED; then FIFO_RD_PTR again. The decode keeps the samples the read popped (RD_PTR after minus before): a read of an empty FIFO returns the last sample again without moving RD_PTR, and a sample that arrives during the read (about 8 ms) is popped too - counting from the pointers before the read dropped it, about one sample in five at 100/s (bench, 2026-10-24). The rate is the 100 samples/s divided by the on-chip averaging (1-16), each rate polled often enough to keep under 8 samples a poll. In multi-LED mode an LED is turned off by setting its current to 0, so the LED actions also choose what is measured (red only for heart rate, red and IR for SpO2, all three). Bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-24, MAX30105): with nothing in front about 1500 (red) and 2400 (IR), a fingertip about 196000 with a 68 bpm pulse of about 1700 p-p in IR.",

,"MS8607PT":{
    "_notes": "TE MS8607 pressure and temperature part at 0x76 (fixed; the humidity part is MS8607RH at 0x40). Commands, not registers: reset 0x1E, convert pressure 0x40-0x4A / temperature 0x50-0x5A (by oversampling), ADC read 0x00 (3 bytes), PROM read 0xA0-0xAC (7 words: word 0 holds a CRC-4, words 1-6 the coefficients C1-C6). Detection: an ADC read, then a second one, which returns 0 whatever went before (datasheet: a repeated ADC read gives 0) - a pattern rather than an ID (a BME280's register 0x00 also reads 0), so it is tried after the records with an ID (identPriority -1). Init: reset, 5 ms. Poll: pressure conversion at OSR 8192 (0x4A, max 16.4 ms), 20 ms (the address is barred), read; temperature conversion (0x5A), 20 ms, read; C1-C6. Decode: TE's first- and second-order compensation (also right for the MS5637 and MS5837-02BA, which share the maths; not the MS5611 or MS5837-30BA). ,"MS8607RH":{
    "_notes": "TE MS8607 humidity part at 0x40 (fixed; the pressure and temperature part is MS8607PT at 0x76). HTU21-style commands: reset 0xFE, measure RH without clock stretching 0xF5 (with stretching, 0xE5, holds the clock longer than the bus timeout), user register read 0xE7. Detection: the user register's fixed bits (reserved bits 5:3 = 0, bit 1 = 1 by default) - weak, so it is tried after the records with an ID (identPriority -1); 0x40 is also used by parts with no record (INA219, PCA9685). Init: reset, 15 ms. Poll: measure (0xF5), 20 ms (max 16 ms at 12 bits; the pause bars the address, as an address probe between trigger and read loses the result), read 3 bytes (RH, CRC with init 0x00 - not checked). RH = -6 + 125*raw/2^16 (status bits 1:0 masked), not temperature-compensated (the MS8607 compensation uses the temperature from the other part: RH + (20 - T) * -0.18).",

,"SCD30":{
    "_notes": "Sensirion SCD30 CO2/temperature/humidity at 0x61 (SEL to GND or floating for I2C: SEL high at power-up selects Modbus and the sensor never answers on I2C). No detection values: 0x61 is in the RSAO identification hook's probe range, and a detection that could fail would let the hook send it framed bytes (as the STCC4, devdocs/stcc4-identification-notes.md). Not scanned while polled (scanWhilePolled false): a scanner presence probe stops it producing data (data-ready never set while probed every few seconds); its polls show it's there. Init: firmware version (0xD100), read the measurement interval (0x4600), start continuous measurement with no pressure compensation (0x0010 0x0000), then set the interval to 2 s only if it differs ({?setInterval}, computed by initCode) as it's stored in non-volatile memory. ASC is left as stored (the autoCal action sets it). Commands are followed by a pause before the read (the SCD30 needs 3 ms). Poll (every 3 s, longer than the 2 s measurement): data-ready (0x0202) twice, then read measurement (0x0300): CO2, T and RH as big-endian floats, each 2-byte half followed by a CRC. Decode: a sample only when the second data-ready word is 1 (a read before data is ready gives 0xFFFF words), with the floats built from their bits. Rates (_conf.rate) only set the poll interval, 3 s to 60 s. Actions (each stored in non-volatile memory): autoCal (automatic self-calibration, 1 on, 0 off), forceCal (forced recalibration to a reference ppm - run in that concentration for at least 2 minutes first), tempOffset (degrees C, subtracted from the temperature), altitude (m); pressure restarts measurement with ambient pressure compensation (mbar, 0 off); softReset. autoCal needs regular fresh air (about 1 hour a day; first correction after about 7 days). forceCal: measure in the reference concentration for at least 2 minutes first.",

    "_notes": "Sensirion STCC4 miniature CO2 sensor (paired with SHT41 for RH/T compensation), fixed address 0x64. Detection is empty (unique address) - the product-ID command cannot be used because the detection path issues a single write+read with no inter-command delay and the STCC4 NACKs that read - so the record claims any device at 0x64. Init: start_continuous_measurement (0x218B). Poll every 1.5 s (longer than the 1 s measurement, so the read always has new data; at 1 s the two drift and a read is NACKed now and then): read_measurement (0xEC05), 1 ms pause, read 12 bytes = CO2/temp/humidity/status words each followed by a CRC byte (skipped via 'at'). CO2 is signed (i16 in the datasheet). Status: only bit 0x0040 (testing mode) is documented; after power-up 0x0100 was seen for about 2 minutes. Actions: testingMode (pauses ASC), pressure (hPa). Forced recalibration isn't an action: it needs measurement stopped (1.2 s), then FRC, then a restart. Datasheet: https://sensirion.com/media/documents/6AED4B15/69295E41/CD_DS_STCC4_D1.pdf. Rates (_conf.rate) only set the poll interval, 1.5 s to 60 s. CO2 raw = ppm; temperature = -45 + 175*s/65535; humidity = -6 + 125*s/65535. Must never be probed by the RSAO delegated-identification hook (its framed 0x99 command stops the sensor measuring); RaftI2C DeviceIdentMgr only runs that hook when no device-type record matches - this record's empty detection always matches, so the hook is never reached at 0x64. See devdocs/stcc4-identification-notes.md testingMode: 1 enable_testing_mode (0x3FBC), 0 disable_testing_mode (0x3F3D); ASC is always on otherwise. pressure: sent as Pa/2, reset to 1013 hPa at power-up.",

    "_notes": "VL6180X ToF proximity sensor with 1x range scaling (RANGE_SCALER 0x0096/0x0097=>0x00fd), so the range is an 8-bit value in mm (0-255). Specified range 0-100mm, typically up to ~200mm with a reflective target and low ambient light\nInit: write 0x0018=>0x01 then wait 100ms, which stops continuous ranging left running by a previous init (the sensor may not have been power cycled) or otherwise does one harmless single-shot range; AN4545 private settings https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an4545-vl6180x-basic-ranging-application-note-stmicroelectronics.pdf; clear SYSTEM__FRESH_OUT_OF_RESET (0x0016=>0x00); GPIO1 interrupt output active low (0x0011=>0x10); readout averaging period 4.3ms (0x010a=>0x30); VHV recalibration every 255 ranges (0x0031=>0xff) and once now (0x002e=>0x01); range inter-measurement period 90ms (0x001b=>0x08); interrupt on new range sample only (0x0014=>0x04); clear interrupts (0x0015=>0x07); start continuous ranging (0x0018=>0x03)\nPoll: RESULT__RANGE_STATUS, RESULT__ALS_STATUS and RESULT__INTERRUPT_STATUS_GPIO (0x004d-0x004f), RESULT__RANGE_VAL (0x0062), then clear interrupts (0x0015=>0x07)\nerr is the range error code (0x004d bits 7:4) and valid is true only when it is 0. With no target in range err is typically 6 (early convergence estimate), 7 (max convergence time) or 11 (signal to noise) and the raw range reads 255\nfresh is 1 when a new range sample completed since the previous poll (0x004f bit 2, new sample ready) and 0 when the poll re-read the previous sample\nSample rate (_conf.rate): the sensor's inter-measurement period (0x001b) is set shorter than the poll interval so that every poll normally sees a new sample. Up to 10Hz the period is 90ms with the default max convergence time 49ms (0x001c=>0x31) and readout averaging 4.3ms. 20Hz uses a 40ms period, 25ms max convergence and 4.3ms averaging. 50Hz uses a 10ms period, 3ms max convergence and 1.8ms averaging (0x010a=>0x08), which reduces range on dark targets and increases noise. Ranging is stopped while the timing is changed and then restarted\nAmbient light sensing (ALS) is not used",
